summary: Retain installation authority and isolate validators across GitHub read redirects

rules.detail: Mutations remain PAT-only and are never replayed.

compatibility.detail: Numeric repository-ID redirects retain installation authorization. Redirect chains carry their effective read source, strip validators when principals change, and prohibit caching a fallback representation under an earlier installation. Unroutable app reads emit the fallback counter and warning.

recovery.detail: Normal binary rollback; no durable schema changes.
